summary: Do not advance last_synced_at unless a resource sync stored rows or finished a complete enumeration.
reason: SaveSyncState always stamps last_synced_at. Using it to clear --full/--latest-only cursors, or after an HTTP 200 non-JSON body that stored nothing, made stale local rows look fresh and suppressed fallback hints.
validated_outcome: Tests cover ResetSyncCursor plus fetch failure preserving the prior timestamp, non-JSON 200 leaving last_synced_at unchanged, and a completed JSON page advancing it.
